author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
I LOVE Old-School fantasy art and I was lucky enough to get my hands on the new set for SORCERY: Contested Realm by Erik's Curiosa. Bob is a HUGE fan of these collectible bespoke card games and when he saw it at the studio demanded we play! Hand-painted new Art by Ian Miller and Gerald Brom? I'm in. Let's check it out!

Set's available HERE: https://sorcerytcg.com/

GMG is publicly supported. Become a backer on Patreon to ensure new content and that the Studio can continue: https://www.patreon.com/guerrillaminiaturegames
